UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Personal profile and health metadata for an authenticated MediFlow user.

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: Full display name of the user.

emergencyContact.description: Emergency contact name or phone number.

avatarUrl.description: Optional Google photo URL or avatar identifier.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Stores personal profile and health details for each authenticated user.
